# Jinhyuk Yoon

> A robotics engineer at CarbonSix, building robot systems and their architecture.

## Work

- [SigmaKit](https://www.carbon6robotics.com/): Physical AI for manufacturing automation (2026 - present)
- [Stark](https://jinhyukyoon.github.io/work/stark/): A laparoscopic telesurgical robotic system (2022 - 2026)
- [Cable-driven Haptic Interface](https://jinhyukyoon.github.io/work/toh2023/): Maximum workspace and comparative study (2020 - 2021)
- [Augmenting Physical Buttons](https://jinhyukyoon.github.io/work/uist2020/): Programmable feels with vibrotactile feedback (2019)

## Archive

- [Interactive Torque Designer](https://jinhyukyoon.github.io/work/interactive_torque_designer/): Dynamic analysis through graphic interaction (2019)
- [Science Communication](https://jinhyukyoon.github.io/work/science_communication/): Public speech and on-stage content (2016 - 2020)
- [Entropy](https://jinhyukyoon.github.io/work/entropy/): Video art metaphor for entropy (2017)
- [Picture Science Project](https://jinhyukyoon.github.io/work/picture_science/): Science with drawing and hands-on activity (2016)
- [TEDxPOSTECH](https://jinhyukyoon.github.io/work/tedx/): Talk conference on the campus (2014 - 2015)
